title: Fixed-width Boolean decrement
statement: Define a partial operation on finite Boolean words as follows: it is undefined on the empty word; on a word whose first bit is true, it changes that bit to false and leaves the rest unchanged; on a word whose first bit is false, it recursively decrements the remaining word and, if that succeeds, changes the first bit to true.
